title: Decrease of the Jacobi measure
statement: Let $A,N,s$ be finite bit strings, and suppose the integer represented by $N$ is odd. If the Jacobi measure of the encoding of $A$ together with the encoding of $N$ and $s$ is positive, one Jacobi step strictly decreases that measure. If the measure is zero, the step leaves the encoding unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: The integer represented by $N$ is odd
